answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one vine plot, pulse meter on its pump. Each epoch it reports pulses; the auditor recomputes volume from the pulse table, and a plume vented every 100 pulses cross-checks the meter. A short count or reused plot burns the bond; an honest grower pays 37 once and reclaims it after audit. First fake 37, kth 37+5(k-1), 1000th 5,032; 1,000 fakes pay 2,534,500. Rented meters fail when vents disagree with pulses.
